title: Delhi Consumer Commission Holds Bata Liable For Not Displaying Prior Notice On Carry Bag Charges
description: The District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, South Delhi, comprising President Ms. Monika A. Srivastava and Member Ms. Kiran Kaushal, held Bata India Pvt. Ltd. liable for deficiency in service for failing to properly inform customers, before purchase, through prominent notices displayed at the store, that paper carry bags were chargeable and optional.
